struct T_CCP_CLIENT_BEARER_LIST_CURRENT_CALLS

Bearer List Current Calls characteristic.

ccp_client.h

Public Members

uint8_t *p_bearer_list_current_calls

A list of current calls.

Each list item in the list of calls shall have the structure.

  • List_Item_Length[i] (1 octet) : Total length of the item, excluding the octet for the List_Item_Length field itself.

  • Call_Index[i] (1 octet): A number chosen by Call Control Server to identify call.

  • Call_State[i] (1 octet): Call State of the Call.

  • Call_Flags[i] (1 octet): A bit field, Call Flags Bit Definitions.

  • Call_URI[i] (variable): Incoming Call URI or Outgoing Call URI.

uint16_t bearer_list_current_calls_len

  • 0 : No calls are available.

  • Other values.

struct T_CCP_CLIENT_INCOMING_CALL_TARGET_BEARER_URI

Incoming Call Target Bearer URI characteristic.

ccp_client.h

Public Members

uint8_t call_index
uint8_t *p_incoming_call_target_uri

URI of the target of an incoming call.

The URI is comprised of the URI scheme followed by the identity of the target of the call.

uri_scheme:identity_target_call.

uint16_t incoming_call_target_uri_len
struct T_CCP_CLIENT_CALL_STATE

Call State characteristic.

ccp_client.h

Public Members

uint8_t *p_call_state

An array of members.

Each 3 octets, and represents an abstraction of the different states that telephone calls are in.

Each member in the array shall have the structure.

  • Call_Index[i] (1 octet): A number chosen by Call Control Server to identify call.

  • State[i] (1 octet): Call State of the Call.

  • Call_Flags[i] (1 octet): A bit field, Call Flags Bit Definitions.

uint16_t call_state_len

  • 0 : No calls are available.

  • Other values.

uint8_t bearer_signal_strength

Level of the signal of the telephone bearer.

  • 0 : No service.

  • 1 to 99 : Meaning of the values is left up to the implementation.

  • 100 : Maximum signal strength.

  • 101 to 254: Reserved for future use.

  • 255 : Signal strength is unavailable or has no meaning for this particular bearer.

uint8_t bearer_signal_strength_reporting_interval

Reporting interval expressed in seconds.

  • 0 : Signal strength is reported as soon as the signal strength changes.

  • 1 to 255.
